purpose: Three public artifacts held out from the earlier writing-plugin corpus. Selection does not imply these publications are clean or unknown to a model.
audience_note: Audiences are evaluator-selected from the publication context and must be held constant across compared conditions.
rubric_policy: Expected answers and grading notes are deliberately absent from this manifest and preparation script.

documents.title: sd - search & displace
documents.audience: Command-line users who know shell pipelines and basic regular expressions and are evaluating or learning sd.
documents.scope: Complete README.md at the pinned commit, including benchmark tables and code examples.

assets.pinning_note: Separate capture of the live external packaging badge linked by the README. It is not versioned with the pinned README commit. This hash pins the captured badge; reproduction fails if the live asset changes. The original README URL is retained.

documents.sequential_scope: Four contiguous chunks at existing section boundaries; concatenation is byte-identical to the complete README. Use the same audience for each chunk.

documents.title: Postmortem on Incorrect Incident Grouping
documents.pinning_note: Publisher provides no immutable revision; prepared article and figure hashes pin the retrieved snapshot. The page metadata modification time does not establish which article wording changed.
documents.license: No reuse license identified on the article; source retained only in temporary evaluation directory.
documents.audience: Spike customers and engineers who operate incident alerting; they know what incidents, dashboards, and Slack alerts are but do not know Spike internal components.
documents.scope: Complete article prose, title, byline, date, all three in-body figures and their captions. Site navigation, related posts, author avatar, and decorative cover image are excluded.
transforms: Decode HTML character references and normalize layout whitespace.
Convert paragraph, heading, emphasis, list, and inline-code markup to Markdown without editing wording.
Replace in-body image URLs with relative local asset paths; retain original URLs in assets metadata.
Join displayed author and publication date with an em dash.

documents.title: FaultProfIT: Hierarchical Fault Profiling of Incident Tickets in Large-scale Cloud Systems
documents.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; derivative test outputs stay outside the repository.
documents.audience: Software engineering research readers familiar with production incidents and machine learning terminology, reading an identified published abstract.
documents.scope: Title, author list, and complete abstract from arXiv v1. No full-paper body, bibliography, or venue metadata is included. This is an abstract-scoped evaluation, not a whole-paper review.
transforms: Decode HTML character references and normalize layout whitespace.
Convert title and abstract labels to Markdown headings; retain author names and links.
Add one display space after the Authors label.
